s.n: Little John's toll bridge bread rolls
s.note: No tolls, then we don't eat no rolls. Rosemary pull-apart rolls, honey butter.
s.how: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, salt, water and oil into a dough and knead until smooth. Cover and leave until doubled. Shape into 12 balls and pack them into a lined tin, then leave to puff. Brush with oil, scatter with rosemary and salt flakes and bake at 210C until golden. Beat the butter with the honey and serve with the warm rolls.
shop: 1 tsp sea salt flakes, plus 1 tsp for the dough@Pantry

s.n: Loxley and Bagelle bagels with lox
s.note: Toasted bagels, smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers. Loxley and Bagel? It can't miss, says Tuckman.
s.how: Beat the cream cheese with the dill, lemon zest and pepper. Toast the bagel halves until golden. Spread thickly with the cream cheese and drape over the salmon. Top with onion and capers and a squeeze of lemon.

m.note: Crackling pork belly, roast apples, gravy. A wild boar? No, that's a wild pig.
m.how: Pat the skin very dry and rub with the salt and fennel seeds. Roast on the onions at 230C for 30 minutes, then at 160C until tender, adding the apples for the last 40 minutes. Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter. Rest the pork, then stir the flour into the pan juices and whisk in the stock and apple juice for gravy. Carve into thick slabs and serve with apples, mash and gravy.

m.n: King Richard's homecoming chicken and leek pie
m.note: Chicken, leek and thyme under golden pastry. It's good to be the king, says the Rabbi.
m.how: Brown the chicken in half the butter and set aside, then soften the leeks in the rest. Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream, mustard and thyme, return the chicken and simmer until thick. Cool the filling, then spoon it into a pie dish. Cover with pastry, crimp, cut a steam hole and brush with egg. Bake at 200C until puffed and deep golden.

w.note: Sweet soufflé omelette with jam and lychee eyeballs.
w.how: Push a blueberry into the hole of each lychee to make eyeballs. Beat the yolks with half the sugar and the vanilla, and whisk the whites with the rest to stiff peaks, then fold together. Melt the butter in an ovenproof pan, pour in the mix and cook gently for 3 minutes, then finish under the grill until puffed. Warm the jam, spoon it over, slide the omelette out, dust with icing sugar and stare back with the lychee eyeballs.

d.n: Rabbi Tuckman's spiced sacramental grape juice
d.note: Warm spiced red grape juice, orange, cinnamon. Sacramental, says Tuckman. For blessing only.
d.how: Put the grape juice, orange and spices in a pot. Warm gently without boiling for 10 minutes. Ladle into cups.

shopping: 1 tsp sea salt flakes, plus 1 tsp for the dough@Pantry
